eras.name: Rise of the Omnics
eras.sub: Automation promises a golden century. Then the factories start thinking for themselves.

eras.name: The Omnic Crisis
eras.sub: Omnic armies pour out of the omniums. Nations fall back. A small international team is formed.

eras.name: The Golden Age
eras.sub: Overwatch becomes the world's symbol of hope, with a covert arm, Blackwatch, operating in the shadows.

eras.name: The Fall
eras.sub: Assassinations, scandal and a catastrophe in Switzerland bring the organization down.

eras.name: The Recall
eras.sub: Years after the ban, Talon grows bolder, and a scientist in Gibraltar sends out a call.

eras.name: Overwatch Returns
eras.sub: A reunited team fights Null Sector's global invasion while new heroes join the fight.

eras.name: Reign of Talon · 2026
eras.sub: The first year-long story arc, told season by season in the live game.

items.d: The Omnica Corporation constructs vast self-running factories, the omniums, to mass-produce robotic workers called omnics. They drive an economic boom across the world.
Investigations into fraud bring Omnica down. The omniums are shut off and left dormant around the globe, which turns out to be a grave mistake.
Without warning, the dormant factories reactivate and begin building war machines. Omnic forces turn on humanity, and conventional militaries cannot keep up.
Egypt's rogue AI, the Anubis God Program, is locked beneath a temple near Giza. Ana Amari makes her name as one of the finest snipers defending Egypt.
The Crusaders hold a castle town in Germany against an omnic assault. Their leader Balderich von Adler falls, and young Reinhardt Wilhelm survives to carry on his legacy.
A strike team of six is assembled: Jack Morrison, Gabriel Reyes, Ana Amari, Reinhardt Wilhelm, Torbjörn Lindholm and Liao. Their mission is to end the Omnic Crisis.
The strike team breaks the omnic forces and the crisis ends. Overwatch is made a permanent international organization, and its agents become heroes.
Jack Morrison is named Strike Commander, passing over his friend Gabriel Reyes. Reyes is given command of Blackwatch, a covert unit for the jobs Overwatch can't be seen doing.
Overwatch builds bases from Gibraltar to Switzerland. Science, medicine and peacekeeping flourish under its banner.

On a moon base where scientists study genetically enhanced apes, the subjects revolt. One gentle, brilliant gorilla named Winston builds a rocket and escapes to Earth, later joining Overwatch as a scientist.
An explosion destroys the omnium in the Australian outback and irradiates the land around it. The survivors, the Junkers, build Junkertown out of the wasteland.
Hanzo Shimada nearly kills his younger brother Genji in Hanamura. Dr. Angela Ziegler rebuilds Genji as a cyborg, and Blackwatch uses him to take apart the Shimada criminal empire.
Young gunslinger Cole Cassidy is captured with the Deadlock Gang and given a choice: prison, or Blackwatch. He takes the badge.
Test pilot Lena Oxton vanishes when an experimental teleporting jet malfunctions, leaving her unstuck in time. Winston builds the chronal accelerator that anchors her to the present.
Angela Ziegler's breakthroughs in nanobiology become the Caduceus staff and Valkyrie suit, letting her heal the wounded in the middle of combat.
Talon kidnaps the wife of Overwatch agent Gérard Lacroix and reconditions her into a cold assassin. Her first target is Gérard himself.
Facing Widowmaker through a scope, Ana Amari hesitates. Widowmaker doesn't. Ana is shot and presumed dead, and she lets the world believe it for years.
A Blackwatch raid in Rialto to capture Talon's Antonio Bartalotti goes badly wrong. Reyes kills Antonio, and the existence of Blackwatch is exposed to the world.
Accusations of corruption, failures and human-rights abuses pile up. Crowds march against Overwatch worldwide and the UN opens investigations.
An explosion levels Overwatch's headquarters in Switzerland. Jack Morrison and Gabriel Reyes are reported dead in the blast.
The United Nations outlaws all Overwatch activity. Agents scatter, and taking part in any Overwatch mission becomes a crime.
A masked vigilante called Soldier: 76 starts attacking corrupt targets, while a wraith named Reaper hunts down former agents. Both men survived Switzerland.
Tekhartha Mondatta, the omnic monk preaching peace between humans and omnics, is killed in London by Widowmaker as Tracer races to stop her.
Talon breaks Akande Ogundimu out of a high-security prison in Numbani. He believes conflict makes humanity stronger, and he means to supply it.
Reaper and Widowmaker raid Watchpoint: Gibraltar. Winston fights them off, then sends out the recall, asking scattered agents to come back.
On the anniversary of his brother's 'death', Hanzo returns to the Shimada castle and finds Genji waiting for him, alive.
South Korea fends off a recurring giant omnic called the Gwishin with MEKA, piloted by top gamers. Hana Song becomes a national hero.
A hacker with her own agenda infiltrates Volskaya Industries alongside Reaper and Widowmaker, using Talon as much as it uses her.
Null Sector, an omnic extremist force, attacks Paris. Winston and Tracer are joined by Mercy, Reinhardt, Mei and more as Overwatch openly returns.
Led by Ramattra, Null Sector strikes Rio de Janeiro, Gothenburg and Toronto. Sojourn, the Overwatch officer, leads the defence alongside the returning team.
Kiriko protects Kanezaka, Junker Queen reclaims her throne, and Illari, Mauga, Venture, Juno, Hazard, Freja and Wuyang widen the fight from Peru to Mars.

Vendetta topples Doomfist and seizes control of Talon, driving Reaper, Widowmaker and Sombra away. Five heroes arrive at once: Domina, Emre and Mizuki for Talon, Anran and Jetpack Cat for Overwatch. Players pick a side in a five-week faction war.

community.summary: Most fans were relieved. To many, the “2” stood for the game's roughest years, and dropping it read as a reset. Blizzard rebranded its game client, launcher and every social account as a “Talon Takeover” in the run-up, which became its biggest social stunt in years. Players came back in numbers, setting a Steam record of 165,651 concurrent players.

voices.gist: One widely shared reaction: players said they had never really called it “Overwatch 2” anyway.
Covered the Talon Takeover rebrand across the client, launcher and socials as the opening move of the story.
Looking back, the team called the launch a success by every measure of player excitement.

items.d: New Recon damage hero Sierra joins as Vendetta's war against the remnants of Overwatch spreads.
Damage hero Shion arrives as the story pushes deeper into Talon's territory.
New tank D.Mon joins in a Busan-themed season with Talon and the Junkers as antagonists. Busan, Eichenwalde and Paraíso are reworked to reflect the story.

Doomfist returns with a new faction and an ally: Doctrine, a 77-year-old vampire-inspired support from Zimbabwe. The Icelandic escort map Watchpoint: Grímsvötn debuts, and Sombra moves to the support role.

Doomfist and Overwatch converge on Rialto to stop Vendetta once and for all. Doomfist wins, and Talon's former Vendetta loyalists Maximilien, Mauga and Moira fall in under his rule. The arc closes with a tease of Hero 55, an omnic support, for 2027.

community.summary: The arc closed with Doomfist's return and his win over Vendetta. The short story “All That Follows”, read by Doctrine's voice actor, set up a new Talon era with Reaper and Widowmaker uneasy about the former Vendetta loyalists. Fans spent the following weeks speculating about Hero 55 and where 2027 goes.

voices.gist: Recap of “All That Follows” and what it means for Talon.
